{"recordId":"3640ef73a415880edd8a9c38","country":"FI","sourceId":"FI-portal","sourceName":"HILMA complete public notices","sourceUrl":"https://www.hankintailmoitukset.fi/en/public/procedure/37748/enotice/57982","noticeId":"EF-57982","procedureId":"EF:37748","title":"Satellite Orthoimages in Finland 2027","description":"GENERAL Please note that this is a prior information notice (hereafter “notice”) and not a call for tenders. The information provided in this notice is preliminary and may change during the preparation phase. Hansel Oy acts in a consultative role in this procurement. DESCRIPTION OF THE PROCUREMENT National Land Survey of Finland ("NLS") is planning to purchase satellite orthoimages covering areas in Finland. The production areas to be ordered are based on the national aerial imaging programme, under which Finland will be aerially imaged over a period of three years, excluding the northernmost parts of Lapland. The upcoming procurement forms part of the NLS' preparedness for the situation where aerial images cannot be obtained from all production areas due to GNSS interference.
